_comment: Work Lamar puts your way. Edited here, reloaded on script start.
ORDER MATTERS. He works down this list in the order it is written and offers you the
first one you have not finished. Only once every job here is behind you does he stop
deciding and let you pick. Finished jobs are remembered by id in the save, so adding a
job or moving one does not re-lock work you have already done.
id          stable key; never change it once a save references it
kind        BikeRide | RideOut | Hit | DriveBy
BikeRide  the scripted push-bike job -- fixed route, no guns on either side
RideOut   ride out, hands only, both sides
Hit       same trip, everybody armed, the corner shoots back
DriveBy   take a car past and shoot it up without stopping
name        the choice he offers you, in his words
brief       what he says when he explains it
done        what he says when you come back paid
targetGang  whose people you are going after -- their models and colours are used
zone        GET_NAME_OF_ZONE code the job happens in, used for the objective wording
x, y, z     the exact corner they stand on. Leave all three at 0 and the job falls back
to the middle of the zone, which for a big zone can be a block away from the
place you actually meant. BikeRide ignores these -- its route is fixed.
targets     how many of them are waiting
homies      how many of yours ride out with you
escapeHeat  true if the law turns up once the work is done. Lamar will not take it off
you until the stars are gone, so the trip home is part of the job.
heatStars   how many stars escapeHeat applies. Ignored when escapeHeat is false.
payMin/payMax  cash, rolled between the two
rep         standing with your own gang for finishing it
minRank     rank before he will offer it at all

missions.name: Come take a ride with me.
missions.brief: Aight, so check it -- them Ballas been up on the Chamberlain courts all week actin' like they got a lease. Nah. Nah nah nah. We ain't shootin' nobody over no basketball, that's embarrassin'. Get a bike, roll out with the homies, we gon' handle it like we was fifteen. Hands, nigga. You pull somethin' out there and I ain't never met you.
missions.done: HA! Look at you! That's how we used to do it, boy. My hand still hurt.

missions.name: Ride through Rancho and lose the car.
missions.brief: You seen Rancho lately? Vagos out there in the projects like they payin' rent on it. And they ain't just standin' -- they sellin'. In Chamberlain, homie. On Davis. Corners we been on since 'fore you could drive.
missions.done: Seen the smoke from the freeway, homie. And ain't nobody got a plate to run, ain't nobody got a body to catch. Vagos gon' sit on they hands and wonder. That's exactly what I wanted.
briefMore: And I can't beat they price. I CAN'T. 'Cause they gettin' it straight off Madrazo's people -- cartel weight, cartel numbers. Us? We buyin' off a man who buyin' off a man. By the time it get to Grimes it cost more than they sellin' it for.

Set's in pieces since Grove went purple, you know that. Half our people workin' for Ballas money now. And I asked Stretch about it -- man looked me in my face and told me leave it alone. Leave it ALONE. Since when do he tell me what to leave alone?
So this ain't through him and it ain't through nobody. It's me and you.

Take the beater out front. Not your car -- I see you look at me like that, homie, NOT your car. Roll through Jamestown, put some rounds in the air, and soon as one of them look up, you gone. You ain't gotta drop nobody neither.
I mean that. We drop a Vago, that's a war, and we ain't got the people for a war right now. This a message. They gotta know somebody still watchin' the block.

Now the part you gon' forget. That car did it. Not you -- the car. Law gon' be lookin' for a description and a plate, and the last time somebody rode out in somethin' with plates they pulled up on the whole set for a week.

So you take it out to that lot by the water in La Puerta, where don't nobody go. Get out, pour the gas over it -- can gon' be right there in your hand, I ain't sendin' you to go shoppin' -- then back up and put a round in it. It'll go.
Fire's loud though. Somebody always call it in. If they come back for you, lose 'em, and then you WALK back here. Not drive. Walk.

missions.name: Go put our set up.
missions.brief: You seen this fool UNIT? Big red letters, all over everything from Forum to the wash. Ballas way, he from over there, and he think this whole side is his sketchpad. Meanwhile our set ain't nowhere. That's on us, homie, that's on us. So get a bike, get a can, and go over the top of him. Four walls, all local, all ours. And go by yourself -- two dudes on bikes with cans is a whole story, one dude is somebody ridin' home. Take your time and do it proper. Somebody come out, that's between you and them. Then bring my bike back.
missions.done: Drove past the one by the wash this mornin'. Straight over the top of him. He gon' see that and he gon' feel somethin', trust me.

missions.name: Rancho. Vagos.
missions.brief: So Vagos got a lil spot out Rancho, right, and they think can't nobody see 'em. I can see 'em! I been seein' 'em! Five of 'em out there postin' up like it's a barbecue. Take three of the homies, everybody with a machine pistol -- don't be takin' no shotgun, this ain't huntin' -- and go remind them. Somebody gon' call the law, they always do, so lose 'em before you come back round here.
missions.done: I heard about that before you even got back. Whole block heard. Take that.

missions.name: Ballas on Grove.
missions.brief: Ballas standin' on Grove like they payin' rent down there. On GROVE, nigga. My granddaddy's street. It's two of 'em, take three homies and everybody carry. Same as Rancho -- you gon' pick up the law on the way out, so don't bring it back to me.
missions.done: THAT'S what I'm talkin' about! Word travels, homie. Word travels.

missions.name: The Vagos need reminding.
missions.brief: La Mesa. Them Vagos gettin' real comfortable over there, real comfortable, smilin' and everything. Drive through, make some noise, and be gone 'fore the law even finish they donut. You ain't gotta be out there all day, homie, it's a message, not a visit.
missions.done: That'll hold 'em a minute. They gon' be lookin' over they shoulder all week.
